sections.content: Use the pretérito perfecto with *antes* de and *después* de to describe a cooking class from beginning to end. The sequence phrases connect completed actions and make the order clear.

items.spanish: Antes de empezar, todos se han lavado las manos.
items.english: Before starting, everyone has washed their hands.

items.spanish: Hemos preparado los ingredientes antes de cocinar.
items.english: We have prepared the ingredients before cooking.

items.spanish: Después de cocinar, hemos probado la comida juntos.
items.english: After cooking, we have tasted the food together.

items.spanish: Antes de marcharse, han hecho una foto.
items.english: Before leaving, they have taken a photo.

sections.content: The verb after *antes* de and *después* de stays in the infinitive: antes de *cocinar*, después de cocinar.
